ELEKS Software Engineering and Development Office is looking for a Trainee Angular Developer in Lviv, Ternopil, Ivano-Frankivsk, or Kyiv.   ABOUT PROJECT Our client is a large financial services company, based in the USA. This company helps financial institutions worldwide grow assets efficiently with its innovative portfolio management suite of data management, investment accounting, and performance measurement solutions.

REQUIREMENTS

Basic knowledge of Angular development. Finished courses or little commercial experience. Upper-intermediate level of English Strong desire to learn and develop new knowledge and skills Great soft skills

RESPONSIBILITIES

Design, develop, and maintain software in line with technical requirements Detect defects, and perform analysis, verification, and debugging of software; correctly interpret bug reports Apply the best software development practices and coding standards Agree on task deadlines with the Technical Leader or Project Manager Track changes and compare source code in the version control system
